notes.title: Pictopix hits 1,000 reviews!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/976b0dbbbf25e27f810f6e16ab994e372913f76d.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

Hope you're well!

[h1][b]1,000 reviews![/b][/h1]

I'm very happy to announce that [b]Pictopix[/b] hits 1,000 reviews! With 96% of positive reviews!!

Thank you very much for all your support and feedback! ːisveryhappyː

Since Pictopix was released in 2017, many of you have been giving feedback and also creating puzzles in the Workshop (over 3,000 now!).

When I started working on Pictopix, I never thought it would get this far.  I first wanted to create a picross game that would appeal to me as a player. Then many of you helped me to improve it, as well as translating it into different languages. It's great to have a community like this. As this is my first solo game (I'd already worked for video game companies before), I've had quite an amazing adventure, and I'd like to thank you all for that ːisheartː

To celebrate the event, Pictopix is currently on sale: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/568320/Pictopix/

[h1][b]What's next?[/b][/h1]

On the other hand, I've got some bad news.

I've been working with the [b]Unity[/b] game engine (the one used to make Pictopix) for almost 10 years now. It's a powerful tool with which many developers have created wonderful games (Hollow Knight, Cuphead, Tunic, etc.).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/26e89903609718228c6b67c476e292c77ad22a6d.png[/img]

Unfortunately, Unity Technnologies has recently changed its pricing structure for developers. Costs are becoming prohibitively expensive for small independent developers like me (and for companies too).

Like many developers, I'm protesting these new fees. As there is little chance of Unity reversing its decision, I will be forced to stop development on this game engine. Which means no more updates for Pictopix. Maybe one day I'll port it to another game engine (a sequel?). As I also have other projects, I don't know yet ːishappyː

In any case, I'd like to thank you for your understanding and wish you lots of fun on Pictopix.

Thanks for your support ːisheartː

Tom

notes.title: Pictopix now available on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/36d4c4184e46ce5b490886789978c481b76f3dc8.png[/img]

Hi everyone, 

I'm very happy to announce that [b]Pictopix[/b] is now available on [b][url=https://www.steamdeck.com]Steam Deck[/url][/b]! ːisstarː


[h1][b]Fully compatible with Steam Deck![/b][/h1]

Today [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/collection/steam/?emclan=103582791470732252&emgid=3113680716502086760]Steam officially launches the [b]Steam Deck[/b][/url]! If you have pre-ordered the console, you will be happy to know that [b]Pictopix[/b] has been updated to be [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/?ctp=6#c3191367619811017310]fully compatible[/url] with the console. The game is now playable with the controller, the trackpad and the touch screen!

With the help of another developer who owns the [b]Steam Deck[/b] (Simon Bachmann who worked on the game [b][url=http://pathway-game.com/]Pathway[/url][/b]), I was able to make sure that [b]Pictopix[/b] worked perfectly on the console. Some parts of the game were tweaked to make the game suitable for the console.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/3a3bc8e8328b543b30a06d1fc6440b76b94b1abe.png[/img]
[i]Thanks Simon for this nice picture![/i]


[h1][b]New puzzle![/b][/h1]

I also made some small corrections and added a new skin in the Interface tab ("Black & White"). And to celebrate the arrival of [b]Pictopix[/b] on [b]Steam Deck[/b], I created a new puzzle in the Workshop. I wish you a lot of fun playing it ːisveryhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/f0930b2f9ffdc5021bfcaf0567b8f9493e4b0a08.png[/img]


[h1][b]Steam Deck owner?[/b][/h1]

You have a Steam Deck? Feel free to share pictures or videos on social media! (see below for links)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/539ac1fd6b2c461be1237e6def8b2e798b60a92a.png[/img]


Have fun on Pictopix and see you soon ːishappyː

Tom

[h2][b]IMPORTANT NOTE![/b][/h2]
Following an update of the Steam Deck, a small setting is necessary to play with the controller: 
- On the Steam page of the game, click on the settings (gear on the right)
- In the drop-down list, click on Properties.
- In Compatibility section, check "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility" and select "Steam Linux Runtime"

notes.title: Pictopix 4th Anniversary & Gifts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/ecd7804d7b541a8b3397325df5b80dbaf640b45c.png[/img]

Hi everybody, 

I wish you all a Happy New Year! ːisheartː

I hope you had a good holiday and enjoyed the Christmas puzzles recently added in Pictopix. If you missed them, feel free to read the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/568320/view/3958066754884392820]previous news[/url]. Of course they are still available.


[h1][b]4th Anniversary[/b][/h1]

Today marks the 4th anniversary of Pictopix! ːisstarː

To celebrate the event, I've added a puzzle in the Workshop. The theme of this puzzle is "Special Event".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/a3e764d1b08c4da5103a41d4dfeb2f5ad253b746.png[/img]

I also have another gift for you...


[h1][b]Special gift[/b][/h1]

A long time ago, in 2009, I was a big fan of a Nintendo game called Picross DS (maybe you played it?) It was the first time I played a game like that. I was so obsessed with it that one day I developed in a few days a little Flash game based on it.

A lot of time passed. Then I recently learned that Adobe company was going to end support of Flash for good. So I dug into my archives to look at the Flash games I had created. And I found the picross game! As Pictopix's birthday was approaching, it was the perfect timing to let you discover this little game I had developed ːishappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/1b68d4f03df3165babeca04a9644cbdc1975386e.png[/img]

So if you want to play the game, just click on this link to download it: http://pictopix.tomlabgames.com/download/PicrossGame.zip

Then unzip the ZIP file in a new directory. I recommend reading the README.txt file before launching the game (double click on the "Run Game" icon).

As you can see, the game is not as complete as Pictopix. There are fifteen levels, a small level editor and... that's it!

For the record, this little game helped me get a job in a video game company ːisveryhappyː

The game is of course free so you are free to share the game with other players. And if you have any questions, don't hesitate!

Have fun and see you soon ːishappyː

Tom

notes.title: New reward system!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/e64f56b83973098c201b9558dff8a7a361ea4e9e.png[/img]

Hey everyone, 

I hope you are all safe and well! I'm pleased to announce a new update for Pictopix! ːishappyː

[h1]Awards[/h1]
A major modification has been made: The way you earn awards (crowns) has been changed! As you can see on the picture below, you now earn more awards when playing in Intermediate and Expert mode. And if you solve a puzzle in Expert difficulty with almost no errors, awards are golden! 

Thus, newcomers to picross games will get more pleasure to make progress and experienced players are still challenged in Pictopix!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/432bc05e18d14b440369e15613a99c24450cf6dd.png[/img]
[i](Game Options > Hints Tab > Awards Section)[/i]

When you launch the game after the update, your game save (awards + achievements) will be updated. Some achievements might be unlocked! ːisveryhappyː

[h1]Patterns[/h1]
Following players' suggestions, it's now possible to choose a pattern for the grid background. Spotting a square or counting squares will be easier and quicker! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27228690/456d69ab0f234ba65752dd1fe8e462aa796d003a.gif[/img]
[i](Game Options > Interface Tab)[/i]

Don't forget that enabling "Preview Filling" (Game Options > Gameplay Tab) displays a squares counter on screen! (more info [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/568320/announcements/detail/1681426132404114091]here[/url])

[h1]Running on background[/h1]
One of your requests was to let the game run when you switch to another application. That's now the case! When the game loses focus, Pictopix no longer pauses. 

If you prefer the game to pause, you can check the "Pause game on focus loss" option (Game Options > Interface Tab)

[h1]And more enhancements![/h1]
As you can see in the changelog ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/?ctp=6#c2248931052741442875]version 1.5.0[/url]), other enhancements have been made to improve the game experience.

Once again, thank you for the feedback and suggestions! ːisheartː

[h1]1,800 puzzles in the Workshop![/h1]
I'm pleased to see that the number of puzzles is still growing in the Workshop. More than 1,800 puzzles have been created by the community! Some puzzles are very nice and originals! Thank you for your contributions ːisveryhappyː

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/3208f95eb785b0294db1e2bbda8e8b514342b0a5.png[/img]

Hello everybody, 

I'm very excited to announce that a new free update is available for Pictopix! This update adds new content and foremost a new game mode: the [b]Mosaics Mode[/b]! :isstar:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hVqKxQN_cxE

[h1][b]Mosaics Mode[/b][/h1]

In this new game mode, you'll have to reveal three large pictures! They are composed of grids of puzzles. Solve the puzzles one after the other for unveiling small parts of the picture. When all of the tiles are completed, the entire image will appear in [b]color[/b]!

You can play the puzzles in any order you like or, if you prefer, click on the Shuffle button (upper right corner of the screen) to pick a random puzzle!

As you can see in game, the size of the puzzles vary from one mosaic to another. In the first mosaic, the puzzles are 10 x 10. In the second one, 15 x 15. And 20 x 20 in the last mosaic!

There are more than a hundred of puzzles to solve! Completing the three large mosaics should take several hours. :ishappy:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/f67230072b594f2571b3c7a9450ac4b4b19896e7.gif[/img]


[h1][b]New Achievements[/b][/h1]

I also added four new achievements in relation to the Mosaics Mode. The most skilled players among you will probably want to earn all the awards in this mode! :isveryhappy:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/9e946a79994bb9f9859050f405266bd90578ce3b.png[/img]


I hope you will have fun with the [b]Mosaics Mode[/b]! Do not hesitate to give feedback :ishappy:

As usual, you can read the full changelog [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/?ctp=2#c3362406825532972107]here[/url] (version 1.4.0). I made some minor fixes and improvements in the game.

Once again, I would like to thank the players who help me translate the game. :isheart:

To celebrate the arrival of the Mosaics DLC, [b]Pictopix is on sale[/b] for several days! Feel free to share the news with your friends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/568320/Pictopix/

Have fun and see you soon! 

Tom

notes.title: Free Christmas puzzles!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/3b3a07bc07e738c058c9d54afe4fde4926194281.png[/img]

Happy Holidays everybody!

I hope you are enjoying some time off with family and relaxing with good games! To celebrate Christmas, I have a gift for you! Some new puzzles and a small update :ishappy:


[h1][b]Christmas puzzles[/b][/h1]

I've added puzzles of various sizes based on Christmas theme in Pictopix. Go in the Workshop, you will see the new puzzles. Do not hesitate to sort the puzzles by "Christmas" theme if you missed those of the past year!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/f2d5bf32477d363fe7cd72b290d217017a778bc5.png[/img]

A little surprise is waiting you when you complete a puzzle on Christmas theme!


[h1][b]Workshop notifications[/b][/h1]

When you run the game, a notification will now appear on some buttons if new puzzles have been added in the Workshop. The notification will display the number of puzzles created since your last visit. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/cd1b2afa34b44cbdab5560ad11660698fb43e542.png[/img]

Besides this new feature, I made some minor tweaks and fixes in the new update ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/?ctp=2#c1743355067087884788]version 1.3.6[/url])


[h1][b]Winter Solstice[/b][/h1]

Today is winter solstice! If you have (almost) finished the classic mode, perhaps you should take a look at puzzles :ishappy:


[h1][b]Two years old[/b][/h1]

On 5 January 2019, Pictopix will be 2 years old! Once again, I'd like to thank all of the people who play Pictopix! Thanks for helping me improve the game and translate it in different languages. Thanks for creating hundreds of puzzles in the Workshop. Thank you also for your positive reviews and feedback! :isheart: 

It's amazing to see players spending hundreds of hours on Pictopix so it makes me very happy! I hope you will continue enjoying Pictopix :isveryhappy:


Wishing you a very Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! :isstar:

Tom

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/6e680e3548dc28b25a266451f11463eeb8cb7c4c.png[/img]

Hello everybody,

To celebrate Halloween, I'm really pleased to announce a new update for Pictopix! 


[h1][b]Halloween[/b][/h1]

Like last year, there is a special event hidden in the game! To discover what it is, here's a little hint: go into the Workshop and play a puzzle in the Halloween theme :ishappy:

Feel free to use the search engine to find puzzles quickly!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/85182daa01c6026f22f2ef4948a35e5f7ed0ed99.png[/img]

Henceforth, this event will be active every year over the same period.

I've also created a [b]new puzzle[/b] in the Workshop. I hope you'll enjoy it!


[h1][b]Preview filling[/b][/h1]

In the new update, Pictopix introduces a new feature named "Preview filling". When this one is enabled, now you can preview the squares that you are filling. Hold the button and move the cursor to highlight squares. Then release the button to fill the squares!

A counter is also displayed next to the cursor. It shows the number of squares highlighted. It can be helpful to count them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/8eae72425bf058b55e452b4160f9216b10be8818.gif[/img]

This feature works with the mouse, the keyboard or the controller! You can enable "Preview filling" in the game options (Gameplay tab)

Some players were asking me regularly this feature. I was reticent at first because I thought the feature will give an advantage to players in Challenges mode, but it does not. :ishappy:


[h1][b]Interface improvement[/b][/h1]

In the previous update ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/?ctp=2#c1734342161852003415]version 1.3.4[/url]), I added the "Thick line" option in the Interface tab. When you check it, the five-block indicator lines are thicker (thanks constantcompile for the suggestion!)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/b688976c23f18beb5e9c2037add607ce6c0190f9.gif[/img]

I also updated some skins and added two new ones ("Classic Dark" and "Amethyst") : 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/3e82cf2506209128eeacdcecf4e3c75ec35e702f.gif[/img]


[h1][b]Translation[/b][/h1]

Once again, I would like to thank the players who help me translate Pictopix in their own language. Sometimes they are not always available so there may be some missing translation. In such cases, feel free to let me know! 


As usual, you will find the full changelog [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/?ctp=2#c1735469327934110124]here[/url] (version 1.3.5).

Have fun and see you soon! :isveryhappy:

Tom

notes.title: Twitch and chat!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/6a16b0b20aa62eea8c2b50d718bc3294d0e5499d.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

I hope you are doing well! I'm glad to announce that Pictopix has got a new update with some special features! The first one is the [b]integration of Twitch[/b]. Let me introduce this new feature! 


[h1][b]Twitch Integration[/b][/h1]

After several tests and iterations of this feature with the help of a few players and the french streamer [url=https://www.twitch.tv/seldell]Seldell[/url] (many thanks to him!), I'm finally satisfied with the Twitch integration.

When the streamers enable this feature, the viewers can interact with the game by typing commands to the Twitch chat! 

For example, if a viewer wants to fill the square at coordinates B 4, he just types "!fill B4". The proposal will be displayed on game screen. The streamer can check the proposal ("!fill 15" in the screenshot) before validating or discarding it.

The streamer can also activate an "Autoplay" option and the most submitted actions will be played automatically after a certain period of time!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/914f2c37ced31f39736e4f60af71aa2f26d72fa5.png[/img]

Following is a list of commands you can type in Twitch chat:
[list]
[*] [b]!fill[/b]: fill blank squares.
[*] [b]!cross[/b]: mark blank squares with crosses.
[*] [b]!mark[/b]: mark temporarily blank squares.
[*] [b]!clear[/b]: clear blank.
[*] [b]!help[/b]: display the commands in chat.
[/list]
The first four commands can be used in this way:
[list]
[*] [b]!fill [letter][/b]: fill a column (for e.g. [i]!fill A[/i])
[*] [b]!fill [number][/b]: fill a row (for e.g. [i]!fill 1[/i])
[*] [b]!fill [letter][number][/b]: fill a square (for e.g. [i]!fill A1[/i])
[*] [b]!fill [letter][number] [letter][number][/b]: fill a line (for e.g. [i]!fill A1 A5[/i])
[/list]
Streamers can enable Twitch Integration in the game options (Streaming tab): 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/cbda4ea2a41a7a012f56e49ca154ecd48cb78b12.png[/img]

Enter your Twitch username then click on "Get OAuth" button. This will open a web page ( https://twitchapps.com/tmi/ ). Click on "Connect with Twitch". Copy the text "oauth:...." (press Ctrl+C to copy the selected text) and paste it in "OAuth Password:" field in Pictopix (press Ctrl+V to paste). Then click "Enable Twitch Integration". The username and the OAuth password will be saved and Pictopix will be connected to Twitch. Just start a puzzle to play with your viewers!

I hope you will appreciate this new game mode! Do not hesitate to give feedback about Twitch Integration. :ishappy:


[h1][b]Discord[/b][/h1]

I've added Rich Presence suppport to Discord. Now you can see which game mode your friends are playing. If one of them is playing Challenge Mode for example, you can join him to try to break his record!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/dc99a77ba5d9622609c9103c063662a33354bc95.png[/img]

Feel to join the [url=https://discord.gg/FkWb7kW]discord[/url] of Pictopix if you want to discuss about the game!


[h1][b]Steam Chat[/b][/h1]

As in Discord, you can see which game mode your friends are playing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/ec4a18713e3e889aaccd3a70a6e4f07ebc89fa2b.png[/img]

If you want to learn more about the Steam Chat update, you can click this link: https://steamcommunity.com/updates/chatupdate

As usual, many fixes and improvements have been made since the last update. Take a look at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/?ctp=2#c1737715419893883400]changelog[/url] (version 1.3.2) to check them out.

Have fun and see you soon! :isveryhappy:

Tom

notes.title: 2 new game modes!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/f6257861ce9aec03f3d407751fe4b4eaec4ae8a1.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

I hope you're all well and that you don't keep on dreaming about small squares… I've been working on a new update – I hope you'll like it. No new puzzles this time but I've added some new game modes: an [b]Endless mode[/b] and a [b]Challenges mode[/b]!

I'll tell you about them. :ishappy:


[h1][b]Endless mode[/b][/h1]

In this game mode the grids are generated at random! Choose the size of the grids you want to have and define other parameters. If you prefer square grids of which the size is a multiple of 5, it's possible! You can therefore customize your puzzle as you wish. An abstract image will be shown at the end of each puzzle – with different colors.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/6412d5a69d2881fd09f1b03aa287c0e5f70c3f88.png[/img]
[i]The interface of Endless mode[/i]

If you want to practice or just do a quick puzzle in Pictopix, Endless mode is a good addition to the puzzles created by the players in the Workshop!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1Xg4IWCqDAJ3y0uql9/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]A random generated puzzle[/i]


[h1][b]Challenges mode[/b][/h1]

If what you like is solving puzzles as quickly as possible, Challenges mode is made for you! Different challenges are presented, notably against the clock. Solve a series of four 5x5 puzzles as quickly as possible. Your time will be saved in a [b]leaderboard[/b]. Not only can you compare your times with other players but also [b]watch their game[/b]! The challenges are renewed every half hour and the leaderboards are stocked for 24 hours.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/795f2ec091d8b81edadbb03abba0aa80e95c0e86.png[/img]
[i]The Challenges mode interface[/i]

As of now there are 4 [b]Time Trials[/b] challenges. I may add other kinds of challenges later!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/t8dX3Pv1LtSFeXtHI7/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Watch players' games![/i]


[h1][b]New achievements[/b][/h1]

To mark the occasion, 4 new achievements have been added and 2 have been modified. The 4 new achievements are linked to the Challenges mode. To unlock them, do the challenges in the time allowed.

The other two are "5 ■ 5" and "10 ■ 10". These were originally created when playing puzzles in Shuffle mode (in Classic mode). They are now linked to Endless mode because they are more appropriate to randomly generated puzzles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/684bf1950329add678d4a85589cf01f9af5db529.png[/img]


[h1][b]Translations[/b][/h1]

I would like once again to thank the players who translate the game. If you can play Pictopix in your own language, it's thanks to them. Excuse me if some parts of the game have not yet been translated. The players do the translations in their own free time so we must give them time to complete them.

Don't hesitate to thank them personally! Their names are in the game credits.

As always, you'll find the modifications in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/?ctp=2#c1694922345929578817]changelog[/url] (version 1.3.0)

Have fun and see you soon! :isveryhappy:

Tom

notes.title: New features!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/2b077bf2fa3c3920c29d1d944a20b0bd8cb2198b.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Here I am again with another update! The welcome you gave to the first anniversary update gave me great pleasure. I got several articles in the press (which you can find on [url=https://twitter.com/Pictopix]twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/pictopix/]facebook[/url]). A website like [b]Rock, Paper, Shotgun[/b] did a great article on Pictopix which you can read [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2018/01/10/pictopix-free-update/]here[/url].

[url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2018/01/10/pictopix-free-update/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/44d01a4b0d317a441efdb477b21486a15a152c6f.png[/img][/url]

I would like to thank the players once again for all the positive feedback and remarks which help me to improve the game.

With this new update I will be replying to your expectations. Here are the new features and improvements: 

[h1][b]Skins[/b][/h1]

The other novelty is that you are now able to select the skin of your choice in the options. This will change the color of some parts of the interface as well as the grid. So, if you would like the background color to be darker while you are playing the game, it's now possible.

For those of you who like tinkering with this sort of thing it is possible to add your own skins in the application's Skins directory. (Default path: \Steam\steamapps\common\Pictopix\Pictopix_Data)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/fb7a51d13e0b2129ada154b956b818c7b909e987.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Cursor[/b][/h1]

As from now you can choose between two types of cursor: the original square one and another which lights up the column and the row you are hovering on. On the bigger grids this can be helpful by making it easier to identify the squares or boxes in the row/column concerned.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/86a35b579ec71d129d3b01b77ced5281cf31ab0b.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Selection of numbers[/b][/h1]

When the hints are disabled it is possible to click on the numbers to gray them out manually. Well this is now possible from the game controller or from the keyboard! It's quite simple – you just have to hold down the LT button or the Alt key. Arrows will come up on the row and column concerned. Select the row or the column with the stick (or the directional arrows) then move along the numbers to gray them out with the A button (or the space bar). When finished release the LT button (or the Alt key) to get the cursor back on the grid.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/47d69c14b13efe97c393779880b9b339fa4878be.gif[/img]

To see the other modifications and corrections you can consult [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/#c1692662302106756414]changelog[/url] (version 1.2.1).

If you'd like to see Pictopix on gog.com one day don’t hesitate to vote on the [url=https://www.gog.com/wishlist/games/pictopix]thread[/url] created by a player. One never knows!

In closing, I would like to thank [b]Red Orc[/b] who has kindly translated the puzzles (Anniversary update) in Japanese.

Have fun and see you soon! ːishappyː

Tom

notes.title: Anniversary Update is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/b201deb466853a68ef5d52ec0839c7003218f77b.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 

It is with great pleasure that I present the [b]Anniversary Update[/b]! Here's what you'll find in the new version of Pictopix:
[list]
[*] 45 new puzzles
[*] Bigger puzzles up to 40 x 40
[*] New achievements
[*] New secrets
[*] Zoom button for big grids
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XRhzB6x_y3Y
According to my tests and calculations the time needed to solve the 45 new puzzles is longer than it was for all 155 initial puzzles! I was astonished to discover that the total playing time is more than doubled with this latest update. I therefore hope that you’ll be happy with it ːishappyː

Quite a lot of modifications and improvements have been made to the game.  To see a list of them, consult the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/3/142260895144062285/#c1620600279663693053]change log[/url] of the 1.2.0 version.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/35d012fde8281e68f1b104f248e5d8fe24d55967.png[/img]
[i]One of the new puzzles[/i]

Once again I'd like to thank the translators who have kindly translated the new puzzles. There are just one language in which the new texts have not yet been translated – Japanese. The translators are players who do this in their free time. I hope you’ll understand that they need time to complete them.

notes.title: Pictopix hits 1,000 puzzles in Steam Workshop!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/b9ad782928fce60592dccbd29526ae9b36a1a519.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

I’m really pleased to tell you that the number of puzzles created by the Pictopix community has now gone past the 1,000 mark! This target was reached on August 15th by [b]Paduk[/b]. [b]Blü[/b] has created a puzzle to commemorate the event. Thank you both and my thanks to all of you who contribute to the Workshop regularly: [b]Misora[/b], [b]Rena[/b], [b]Korb3n[/b], [b]Ishtar[/b], [b]Cakoka[/b], [b][CN]sunyatsen6[/b], [b]Hennihenner[/b], [b]Kethlak[/b], [b]Nupfi[/b], [b]Klaus Otto[/b]... There are certainly many more I have forgotten!
 
One thousand, that's a lot of puzzles. New players could be a bit lost. Don't hesitate to use the different sort options to play your favorite puzzles!

[h1][b]About the 3 crown note system[/b][/h1]
I would like to take the opportunity of this announcement to sound out your ideas on the 3 crown note system. Do you find this is fair or would you prefer that the third crown didn't depend on the number of errors?

Here are some changes I could make:
[quote]
- 1 crown :  finishing a puzzle in Novice mode (The hints Highlight and Fade Numbers activated.)
- 2 crowns : finishing a puzzle in Intermediate mode (The hint Fade Numbers activated.)
- 3 crowns : finishing a puzzle in Expert Mode (No hints activated)
[/quote]
I could add one or more Achievements to players who finish the bigger puzzles with practically no errors.

Let me know what you think!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/c18d2ccafe5434029eaed7c23d24d04604cd79c8.png[/img]

As usual an update comes with this announcement ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/3/142260895144062285/#c2183537632740342805]version 1.1.17 - Changelog[/url]). The game has been improved yet again and some translations have been corrected.

Your remarks and suggestions are always welcome. Thanks again and good gaming!!! ːisveryhappyː

Tom

notes.title: 3 more languages and featured in RPS' Top games 2017!
notes.content:
With this new update ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/3/142260895144062285/#c1353742967804701473]version 1.1.12[/url]), Pictopix has been further enriched with yet more languages! This time it's Russian, Japanese and Turkish which have been added. I'd like to thank the Tolma4 team, Wasabim and Aydın Aslangören for their translations and their friendliness.

The game is now available in 9 different languages. Here's the full list up to date:
- English
- Czech
- French
- Hungarian
- Japanese
- Russian
- Spanish
- Simplified Chinese
- Turkish

If you want to translate the game into your own language don't hesitate to get in touch with me using this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdYXMGU0cFha03p24ZbuEfei1rSURg1TPQq5HicB7atZn_DeQ/viewform]contact form[/url].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/4b3f184a623866c18ad22e45d2608fd34cd91b27.png[/img]

Some small modifications have also been made. You can see the details [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/3/142260895144062285/#c1353742967804701473]here[/url].

This news bulletin is also to let you know that Pictopix is now listed in the "[url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2017/06/06/best-pc-games-2017/28/]Top Best Bestest Games Of 2017 So Far[/url]" at [b]Rock, Paper, Shotgun[/b]!  This is a proud day for me. I hope that you, the players, like the game too. I will try to continue to improve it in accordance with your wishes.

Thanks once again and "good gaming"! ːisveryhappyː
